- [Ebola reaches Kenya: what's happening and what it means for you](https://trendsincoming.com/blog/ebola-outbreak-kenya-explained/): Kenya has confirmed seven Bundibugyo Ebola cases, all found in quarantine, as DR Congo's outbreak passes 9,000 cases.
